title: Aye momino Hussain ka tum par salaam hai
body:
izzat hain kya veqaar hain kya ehteram hai
soncho to eak pal ke liye kya maqaam hain
<<MINI>>
bimaar-e-karbala ka yeh hum ko payam hain
<<DIVIDER>>
aye momino hussain ka tum par salam hai
1. farsh-e-aza bichao karo majlis-e-hussain
dengi duwaein tumko muhammed ki noor-e-ain
is gham mein chaho jitna karo kam hain shor-o-shain
<<MINI>>
bimaar-e-karbala ka yeh hum ko payam hain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. har gaam karbala thi shah-e-mashraqain ko
ghurbat mein chain kab mila zehra ke chain ko
asghar ke baad hogayi fursath hussain ko
<<MINI>>
bimaar-e-karbala ka yeh hum ko payam hain
<<DIVIDER>>
3. maqsad ki aabroo hain saahadat hussain ki
maqtal mein charsu hai shahadat hussain ki
ta hashr surq rooh hain shahadat hussain ki
<<MINI>>
bimaar-e-karbala ka yeh hum ko payam hain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. maa bain-e-kayenath ye tanha hai waqaya
piri mein noujavan ka laasha uthaliya
mazloom yeh hussain pe hai raat e ambiya
<<MINI>>
bimaar-e-karbala ka yeh hum ko payam hain
<<DIVIDER>>
5. aakhon mein aaj tak hai woh manzar hussain ka
zakhmon se chur chur tha paikar hussain ka
veeran ho chuka tha bhara ghar hussain ka
<<MINI>>
bimaar-e-karbala ka yeh hum ko payam hain
<<DIVIDER>>
6. hangam-e-asr jiski shahadat hai momino
uska hi zikr taab-a-qayamat hai momino
yeh gham manao ain-e-ibadath hai momino
<<MINI>>
bimaar-e-karbala ka yeh hum ko payam hain
<<DIVIDER>>
7. aye momino qayaal rahe dil mein ye sada
wo dashte karbala ho ke majlis-e-aza
jannat se farsh-e-qaak pe ati hain fatima
<<MINI>>
bimaar-e-karbala ka yeh hum ko payam hain
<<DIVIDER>>
8. yeh majlise yeh zikr yeh matam yeh marsie
mashko alam yeh phool yeh jhola yeh tazie
yeh sab nashaniya hai aza-e-hussain ke
<<MINI>>
bimaar-e-karbala ka yeh hum ko payam hain
<<DIVIDER>>
9. taskeen e khalbe fatima yeh gham yeh anjuman
qayam rahe fareed yeh matam yeh anjuman
ahle aza se kehti hai hardam yeh anjuman
<<MINI>>
bimaar-e-karbala ka yeh hum ko payam hain
